data.title: First reminder: Muster Magazin subscription
data.summary: Muster Verlag GmbH sent a first reminder (1. Mahnung) dated 13 June 2025 for the unpaid annual fee of the "Muster Magazin" subscription. The total due is €61.90 by 30 June 2025.
data.explanation: The publisher says your annual subscription fee of €59.40 is still unpaid and has added a reminder fee of €2.50. Please transfer €61.90 to the account named in the letter by 30 June 2025. If you have already paid, the letter says you can ignore it. If you think the claim is wrong, contact the publisher's customer service. Paying promptly avoids further reminders and possible additional fees.
